name: Yo-yo
summary: Yo-yo with two round discs on a string, hanging from a finger loop; anim updown makes it bob up and down the string.

params.name: y
params.note: top of the string: the finger loop hangs from y; the yo-yo drops about 170 px on updown, so keep y above about 800

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size: at s = 1 the disc is about 300 px wide and the yo-yo about 560 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: updown = the yo-yo drops to the end of the string and climbs back

author: krakujs
